sources.snippet: Dose calculation in pyRadPlan produces a *dose influence matrix* (``dij``) that encodes the dose deposited in every voxel by every beamlet. The influence matrix is the central data structure for optimization: the dose for any fluence vector ``w`` is simply the matrix-vector product ``dij · w``. Two top-level functions are provided:
